SELECT distinct p.id, p.organizationid, p.createdat, p.amount, p.riskstatus, p.status, p.partnername
FROM FVTRN_MELIO.PAYMENTS p
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.ORGANIZATIONS o ON o.ID = p.organizationid
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.VENDORS v ON v.ID = p.VENDORID
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.DELIVERYMETHODS dm ON dm.ID = p.DELIVERYMETHODID
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.BANKACCOUNTS ba ON dm.BANKACCOUNTID = ba.ID
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.RISKENGINEDECISIONS red ON red.PAYMENTID = p.id
    LEFT JOIN prod.ANALYTICS.RISK_PAYMENTS rp on rp.PAYMENT_ID = p.id
where v.contactemail is not null
and ((((proxy = 'true') or (MM_paymentIP >= 10) or (Ip_distance>99)) and p.amount >= '6000') or p.amount >= '12000')
and o.createdat >= dateadd(day, -14, current_date())
and dm.createdat >= dateadd(day, -14, current_date())
and o.createorigin = 'user-signup'
and dm.deliverytype <> 'check'
and p.riskstatus<>'declined'
AND rp.org_ode_decision <> 'reject'
and p.partnername<>'paypal'
order by p.createdat desc

SELECT p.id, p.organizationid, p.createdat as pcreation, dm.createdat as dmcreation, v.contactemail as vendoremail, p.amount, p.status, p.riskstatus, p.partnername, ba.routingnumber
FROM FIVETRAN_CDC.FVTRN_MELIO.payments p
LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.RISKENGINEDECISIONS red ON red.PAYMENTID = p.id
LEFT JOIN FIVETRAN_CDC.FVTRN_MELIO.deliverymethods dm on p.deliverymethodid = dm.id
LEFT JOIN FIVETRAN_CDC.FVTRN_MELIO.organizations o on p.organizationid = o.id
LEFT JOIN FIVETRAN_CDC.FVTRN_MELIO.bankaccounts ba on dm.bankaccountid = ba.id
LEFT JOIN FIVETRAN_CDC.FVTRN_MELIO.VENDORS v on v.id = p.vendorid
LEFT JOIN prod.ANALYTICS.RISK_EMAILAGE_VENDOR ev on p.id = ev.paymentid
where dm.createdat > dateadd(day, -7, current_date())
and p.amount > 2500
and riskstatus <> 'declined'
and dm.deliverytype not in ('check', 'virtual')
and p.partnername <> 'paypal'
order by 2 desc

WITH last_action_table AS (SELECT    
                organizationId,
                max(id) AS last_action_id
    FROM FIVETRAN_CDC.DECISION_ENGINE_DECISION.ORGANIZATIONDECISIONS
    GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT DISTINCT(p.ID) AS PaymentID,
concat('https://mos.production.melioservices.com/sherlock/general/live?paymentId=',p.id) as link,
o.COMPANYNAME AS OrgCompanyName,
p.organizationid,
o.TAXIDTYPE, 
p.AMOUNT,
p.riskstatus,
p.STATUS,
p.createdat AS Pmtcreated,
p.SCHEDULEDDATE AS PmtScheduledDate,
p.partnername,
od.decision AS ODE,
o.createdat AS OrgCreatedAt,
ba.ROUTINGNUMBER,
v.COMPANYNAME AS VendorName,
dm.createdat AS DmCreatedAt,
v.CONTACTEMAIL AS VendorEmail,
num_payments,
json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorIdmMMScore') AS payorIdmMMScore,
json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorWpClientIpNetworkScore') AS payorWpClientIpNetworkScore,
json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorWpClientIpIdentityScore') AS payorWpClientIpIdentityScore
FROM FVTRN_MELIO.PAYMENTS p
LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.RISKENGINEDECISIONS red ON p.id = red.paymentId
LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.ORGANIZATIONS o ON o.ID = p.ORGANIZATIONID
LEFT JOIN last_action_table la ON o.id = la.organizationId
JOIN DECISION_ENGINE_DECISION.ORGANIZATIONDECISIONS od on od.id = la.last_action_id
LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.DELIVERYMETHODS dm ON p.DELIVERYMETHODID = dm.ID
JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.VENDORS v ON v.ID = dm.VENDORID
JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.BANKACCOUNTS ba ON dm.BANKACCOUNTID = ba.ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT organizationId, count(id) num_payments from FVTRN_MELIO.PAYMENTS GROUP BY 1) op ON op.organizationID = o.id
WHERE p.amount BETWEEN 9000.00 AND 10000.00
AND red.mode = 'live'
AND json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorWpClientIpNetworkScore') > 0.600
AND json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorWpClientIpIdentityScore') > 400
AND od.decision != 'reject'
AND ((ba.routingnumber = '026014902'
OR ba.routingnumber = '041215663'
OR ba.routingnumber = '124303120'
OR ba.routingnumber = '073972181'
OR ba.routingnumber = '084106768'
OR ba.routingnumber = '103100195'
OR ba.routingnumber = '031101279'
OR ba.routingnumber = '124303201'
OR ba.routingnumber = '021214891'
OR ba.routingnumber = '124303162'
OR ba.routingnumber = '124303214')
or o.TAXIDTYPE = 'SSN')
and dm.createdat > '2025-12-01'
and p.createdat >= dateadd(day, -5, current_date())
order by p.createdat desc

    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.VENDORS v ON v.ID = p.VENDORID
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.DELIVERYMETHODS dm ON dm.ID = p.DELIVERYMETHODID
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.BANKACCOUNTS ba ON dm.BANKACCOUNTID = ba.ID
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.RISKENGINEDECISIONS red ON red.PAYMENTID = p.id
    LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.DOMESTICWIREACCOUNTS dwa on dm.DOMESTICWIREACCOUNTID=dwa.id

and dm.deliverytype <> 'check'
and p.partnername<>'paypal'

from FVTRN_MELIO.PAYMENTS pp

WITH last_action_table AS (SELECT    
                organizationId,
                max(id) AS last_action_id
    FROM FIVETRAN_CDC.DECISION_ENGINE_DECISION.ORGANIZATIONDECISIONS
    GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT DISTINCT(p.ID) AS PaymentID,
concat('https://mos.production.melioservices.com/sherlock/general/live?paymentId=',p.id) as link,
o.COMPANYNAME AS OrgCompanyName,
p.organizationid,
o.TAXIDTYPE, 
p.AMOUNT,
p.riskstatus,
p.STATUS,
p.createdat AS Pmtcreated,
p.SCHEDULEDDATE AS PmtScheduledDate,
p.partnername,
od.decision AS ODE,
o.createdat AS OrgCreatedAt,
ba.ROUTINGNUMBER,
v.COMPANYNAME AS VendorName,
dm.createdat AS DmCreatedAt,
v.CONTACTEMAIL AS VendorEmail,
num_payments,
json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorIdmMMScore') AS payorIdmMMScore,
json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorWpClientIpNetworkScore') AS payorWpClientIpNetworkScore,
json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorWpClientIpIdentityScore') AS payorWpClientIpIdentityScore
FROM FVTRN_MELIO.PAYMENTS p
LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.RISKENGINEDECISIONS red ON p.id = red.paymentId
LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.ORGANIZATIONS o ON o.ID = p.ORGANIZATIONID
LEFT JOIN last_action_table la ON o.id = la.organizationId
JOIN DECISION_ENGINE_DECISION.ORGANIZATIONDECISIONS od on od.id = la.last_action_id
LEFT JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.DELIVERYMETHODS dm ON p.DELIVERYMETHODID = dm.ID
JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.VENDORS v ON v.ID = dm.VENDORID
JOIN FVTRN_MELIO.BANKACCOUNTS ba ON dm.BANKACCOUNTID = ba.ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT organizationId, count(id) num_payments from FVTRN_MELIO.PAYMENTS GROUP BY 1) op ON op.organizationID = o.id
WHERE p.amount BETWEEN 9000.00 AND 10000.00
AND red.mode = 'live'
AND json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorWpClientIpNetworkScore') > 0.600
AND json_extract_path_text(try_parse_json(red.modelResult), 'features.payorWpClientIpIdentityScore') > 400
AND od.decision != 'reject'
AND ((ba.routingnumber = '026014902'
OR ba.routingnumber = '041215663'
OR ba.routingnumber = '124303120'
OR ba.routingnumber = '073972181'
OR ba.routingnumber = '084106768'
OR ba.routingnumber = '103100195'
OR ba.routingnumber = '031101279'
OR ba.routingnumber = '124303201'
OR ba.routingnumber = '021214891'
OR ba.routingnumber = '124303162'
OR ba.routingnumber = '124303214')
or o.TAXIDTYPE = 'SSN')
and dm.createdat > '2025-12-01'
and p.createdat >= dateadd(day, -5, current_date())
order by p.createdat desc
